### After Code Changes — Build & Deliver APK
1. Build: `buck2 build instagram_64bit_noexo --show-output`
2. Get the APK path from the build output
3. Get your username: run `whoami` and save the result as USERNAME
4. Get a timestamp: run `date +%s` and save the result as TIMESTAMP
5. Upload: `manifold put <APK_PATH> ig4a-claude-inspector/flat/USERNAME_TIMESTAMP.apk`
6. Return the clickable download link: `https://interncache-all.fbcdn.net/manifold/ig4a-claude-inspector/flat/USERNAME_TIMESTAMP.apk`
